basic_details.short_information: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus has invited applications for 1 Intern post at Kollam, Keralam. The listed qualification is Btech, the job category is Project, and the last date to apply is 11 November 2026. Applications are made online through the Apply Online link on the Amrita job page.

how_to_apply: Open the Intern @ Amritapuri job page on the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham website.
Use the Apply Now / Apply Online link on that page to submit your application.
Submit the application on or before 11 November 2026.
For details, the notice gives the contact email [email protected]. It does not list documents or any form-filling steps.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Intern at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notice does not specify the pay, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university with a campus at Amritapuri, in Kollam, Keralam. The Amritapuri Campus has posted this Intern vacancy on the Jobs section of its website. The post is listed under the job category Project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists a single vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The qualification printed for the Intern post is Btech. The notice does not mention any desirable qualification, experience requirement or age limit. Candidates should check the application page for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist the Team lead in various departmental projects.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Intern
content_sections.text: Open the Intern @ Amritapuri job page on the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham website. Use the Apply Now / Apply Online link on that page to submit your application. Submit the application on or before 11 November 2026. For details, the notice gives the contact email [email protected] . It does not list documents or any form-filling steps.
